maps.color: surface colour, with transparency for leaves; load as sRGB
maps.normal: surface lighting detail, OpenGL (+Y) convention; load as linear data
maps.roughness: how matte the surface is, identical in R, G and B; load as linear data

formats.bc7: BC7 with Zstandard compression, for GPUs that support BC7, commonly desktops
formats.uastc: Basis Universal UASTC with Zstandard compression; the loader converts it to a format the GPU supports
